gen.title: How Mach number affects density and compressibility

cards.stem: For which flows does density change faster than velocity by the square of Mach number?
options: For low speed, or subsonic conditions
cards.quote: For supersonic and hypersonic flows, the density changes faster than the velocity changes by a factor equal to the square of the Mach number.

cards.stem: For which flows is density change nearly equal to velocity change?
cards.quote: For transonic flows, the change in density is nearly equal to the change in velocity, and compressibility effects cannot be ignored.
For the low subsonic conditions, compressibility can be ignored.

options: The Mach number is the ratio of the speed of the aircraft
The speed of sound is equal to the speed of transmission
cards.quote: The Mach number is the ratio of the speed of the aircraft, or the speed of the gas, to the speed of sound in the gas.
